raw.title: Sr. Medical Quality Auditor Risk Adjustment
raw.excerpt: The Senior Risk Adjustment Quality Auditor utilizes their expertise and industry standard coding guidelines in performing quality accuracy audits for both internal Companies Coders and external Vendors, Partners, and Provider Groups, ensuring the accuracy of ICD-10 coding and claims data for CMS/HHS risk adjustment data submissions.
raw.description:
The Senior Risk Adjustment Quality Auditor utilizes their expertise and industry standard coding guidelines in performing quality accuracy audits for both internal Companies Coders and external Vendors, Partners, and Provider Groups, ensuring the accuracy of ICD-10 coding and claims data for CMS/HHS risk adjustment data submissions. The Senior Risk Adjustment Quality Auditor shall assist Leadership with the quality audit processes, identify trends and opportunities for training and education. This position shall utilize critical thinking skills and effective communication to ensure coding compliance and oversight of same.

Important to Know

  • Candidates that move forward in the process may be asked to complete an assessment that simulates the responsibilities of this role

  • CRC (Certified Risk Adjustment Coder from AAPC) is required

  • One of the following certifications is required in addition to the CRC certification

    • CPC (Certified Professional Code from AAPC)

    • COC (Certified Outpatient Coder from AAPC)

    • CIC (Certified Inpatient Coder from AAPC)

    • CCS (Certified Coding Specialist from AHIMA)

    • CCS-P (Certified Coding Specialists Physician Based from AHIMA)

What You Will Be Doing

Internal Audit Accountabilities

  • Execute audit procedures as outlined by Leadership including perform and document findings of quality accuracy reviews/quality audits of coding and documentation completed by Companies Internal Risk Adjustment Coders/Auditors to ensure consistency and accuracy of ICD-10 coding and industry standards.

  • Advise Companies Internal Coders/Auditors on proper code selection, documentation guidelines as well as assist with training and education.

  • Research and communicate ICD-10, Coding Clinics, and other industry standard guidance, when appropriate, for facilitating quality review findings and education.

External Audit Accountabilities

  • Perform and document findings of quality accuracy reviews/quality audits of coding and documentation completed by External Vendors, Partners and/or Provider Groups to ensure consistency and accuracy of ICD-10 coding.

  • Research and communicate ICD-10, Coding Clinics, and other industry standard guidance, when appropriate, for facilitating quality accuracy reviews/quality audits findings.

  • Communicate with external Vendors, Partners and/or Provider Groups to share out audit results and educational materials.

Senior Audit Accountabilities

  • Escalates trends in quality accuracy reviews/quality audits findings to Leadership and provide suggested corrective actions

  • Assists Leadership and resources to support audit scope, deadlines, and objectives.

  • Assist Leadership with improvements to the quality accuracy reviews/quality audits process, identifying risks, evaluating controls, and preparing documentation.

  • Assists in developing, maintaining, and updating departmental procedures, workflows, and other work tools/job aides. (30%)

What We Require

  • 4+ years related work experience or equivalent combination of transferable experience in Risk Adjustment Coding, Auditing, Coding Accuracy experience and/or Provider Education

  • Related Bachelor’s degree or additional related equivalent work experience or equivalent work experience

  • Demonstrated knowledge of CMS and HHS Risk Adjustment Programs Experience resolving escalated issues and barriers. Excellent communication and collaboration skills both with internal and external audiences Knowledge of health plan operations Knowledge of provider operations

  • CRC (Certified Risk Adjustment Coder from AAPC) Upon Hire

  • At least one of the following upon hire:

    • CPC (Certified Professional Code from AAPC)

    • COC (Certified Outpatient Coder from AAPC)

    • CIC (Certified Inpatient Coder from AAPC)

    • CCS (Certified Coding Specialist from AHIMA)

    • CCS-P (Certified Coding Specialists Physician Based from AHIMA)

What We Prefer

  • Bachelor’s degree Bachelor’s degree in any subject matter or equivalent work experience

  • Experience using Full ICD-10 CM code capture

  • CPMA (Certified Professional Medical Auditor from AAPC) Upon Hire

  • Demonstrated Florida Blue knowledge

  • Demonstrated understanding of CMS compliance standards

General Physical Demands
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.


What We Offer

As a Florida Blue employee, you will thrive in our Be Well, Work Well, GuideWell culture where being well as an individual, and working well as a team, are both important in serving our members and communities.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and a comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Annualized Offer/Hiring Range: $71,200 - $89,000

Annualized Salary Range:$71,200 - $115,700

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

Job Description

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

At Amgen, the Marketing Associate Director at Amgen leads the development and implementation of strategic marketing plans and activities. They coordinate with other departments, analyze market trends and consumer behavior, and align marketing efforts with the overall company goals.

What you will do

The TEZSPIRE Associate Director of Marketing will serve as the strategic engine behind Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) excellence, collaborating with our co-promote partners at AstraZeneca in leading end-to-end campaign activation, driving launch readiness, and translating performance into measurable business impact. This leader will operate at the intersection of strategy, creativity, analytics, and execution to ensure every campaign not only launches successfully—but performs powerfully.

Specific Responsibilities:

Strategic DTC Leadership

  • Shape and champion the DTC vision, ensuring strategy is clearly articulated, seamlessly executed, and fully aligned to brand and franchise priorities.
  • Anticipate evolving brand needs and build campaigns that are differentiated, insight-driven, and tailored to maximize impact across channels.
  • Serve as the central DTC connector and strategic lead across Amgen and AZ, ensuring alignment, clarity, and momentum.

Cross-Functional & Media Leadership

  • Partner across functions and with AZ counterparts to elevate creative quality, media precision, and performance rigor.
  • Drive best-in-class media strategy, execution, measurement frameworks, and KPI governance.
  • Proactively identify risks, remove barriers, and course-correct in real time to maximize impact and ROI.

Performance Storytelling & Executive Influence

  • Translate complex analytics into clear, compelling narratives.
  • Deliver executive-ready insights that inform decisions, inspire confidence, and drive strategic alignment.
  • Elevate performance reporting from data recaps to forward-looking business recommendations.

Patient Access & Impact Acceleration

  • Act as the quarterback for patient access integration, ensuring access strategies are embedded early and amplified through DTC efforts.
  • Identify innovative opportunities to enhance access visibility and drive meaningful patient impact.

Win

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a candidate with these qualifications.

Doctorate degree and 3 years of Marketing experience

OR

Master’s degree and 5 years of Marketing experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of Marketing experience

OR

Associate’s degree and 12 years of Marketing experience

OR

High school diploma / GED and 14 years of Marketing experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior marketing and/or agency experience in healthcare

• Experience creating marketing materials and taking them through internal review

• Knowledge of the market research process and principles

• Expertise working across multiple projects and managing multiple external vendors

• Strong planning, project management, communication, and organization skills

• Team-oriented attitude and excellent collaboration skills

• Experienced in managing tactics through the regulatory approval process

• Proficient in Microsoft Office

• Professional, proactive demeanor

• Strong interpersonal skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Requires approximately 15-20% travel

Thrive

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’

professional and personal growth and well-being. In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan comprising health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities including:

  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.

  • Stock-based long-term incentives

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

We are looking for a Senior Regional Marketing Specialist to join our Marketing team. This is a remote role based in Toronto, reporting to the Senior Field Marketing Manager.

As a Senior Regional Marketing Specialist, you'll spearhead communication strategies that resonate with our target audience across Canada. You'll be the driving force behind sales collaboration, ensuring seamless alignment between marketing efforts and the sales team's objectives to optimize ROI and execute with unparalleled efficiency.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Principal Machine Learning Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

You will be responsible for overseeing the design, development, and deployment of machine learning models that power and enhance our financial platform. In this role, you will drive the creation of scalable machine learning solutions for personalized recommendations in the Sezzle marketplace, fraud detection, and credit risk assessment, utilizing a combination of cloud services, open-source tools, and proprietary algorithms.

Your leadership will be key in blending machine learning development and operations (MLOps) to automate and optimize the full lifecycle of our ML models. You will collaborate with a team of engineers and data scientists to build large-scale, high-quality solutions that address diverse challenges in the shopping and fintech space. You’ll ensure our AI-driven features are robust, efficient, and scalable as we continue to grow.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, Build, and Maintain Scalable ML Infrastructure: Lead the design and development of scalable machine learning infrastructure on AWS, utilizing services like AWS Sagemaker for efficient model training and deployment.
  • Collaborate with Product Teams: Work closely with product teams to develop MVPs for AI-driven features, ensuring quick iterations and market testing to refine solutions effectively.
  • Develop Monitoring & Alerting Frameworks: Create and enhance monitoring and alerting systems for machine learning models to ensure high performance, reliability, and minimal downtime.
  • Support Cross-Departmental AI Utilization: Enable various departments within the organization to leverage AI/ML models, including cutting-edge Generative AI solutions, for different use cases.
  • Provide Production Support: Offer expertise in debugging and resolving issues related to machine learning models in production, participating in on-call rotations for operational troubleshooting and incident resolution.
  • Scale ML Architecture: Design and scale machine learning architecture to support rapid user growth, leveraging deep knowledge of AWS and ML best practices to ensure robustness and efficiency.
  • Mentor and Elevate Team Skills: Conduct code reviews, mentor team members, and elevate overall team capabilities through knowledge sharing and collaboration.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Stay updated with the latest advancements in machine learning technologies and AWS services, driving the adoption of cutting-edge solutions to maintain a competitive edge.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Physics, or a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 6+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with demonstrated success in deploying scalable ML models in a production environment.

Ideal Skills & Experience:

  • Deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: machine learning, recommendation systems, pattern recognition, data mining, artificial intelligence, or related technical fields.
  • Proven track record of developing machine learning models from inception to business impact, demonstrating the ability to solve complex challenges with innovative solutions.
  • Proficiency with Python is required, and experience with Golang is a plus.

We are building a best-in-class commercial organization by establishing a repeatable go-to-market motion, hiring a team of high caliber Enterprise SaaS sales, marketing, and customer success professionals, and thoughtfully engaging VPs, General Managers, and other corporate decision makers across the Medical Device Industry.

This Role

Reporting into the Director of Revenue Operations, you will bring an analytical approach, thoughtfulness, and curiosity to our newly formed team as we champion the effort to achieve Commercial Excellence at AcuityMD. You will help establish best practices across revenue strategy, analytics, sales processes, and tech stack management that will drive results now and in the future as we build for scale.

  • Project Management: Organize status meetings, manage project timelines, and facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure seamless execution of campaigns. Maintain detailed meeting notes and action items.

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years in marketing operations or digital marketing roles with a strong focus on execution and campaign management. Proven track record of managing reporting for multi-channel campaigns and sales outbound efforts reporting that drive measurable results.

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. Department: Business Development

Location: Remote, US

Reports to: COO

This full-time, remote position is located in the US. This person should be willing to accommodate hours across multiple US time zones.

About SecondMuse LLC

At the heart of SecondMuse lies the fundamental strategy: Drive Impact. This guiding principle is ingrained in every decision we make as individuals and collectively as a company. It reflects our identity, our purpose, and the unique value we deliver to our clients. Our commitment to driving impact shapes our strategic approach and is mirrored in our diverse offerings. These offerings are designed to foster just economies, powered by community-driven solutions with a focus on generating substantial economic, social, and environmental benefits. Our services range from consulting, aimed at catalyzing long-term impact through innovative projects and building strategic relationships, to Entrepreneurial Support, facilitating opportunities for entrepreneurs at various stages of their journey. Further, we are engaged in economy-building initiatives that catalyze systemic changes and economic transformation across sectors. We have organized innovation programs in over 100 countries and 250 cities, sourcing solutions from every corner of the world. Each program has challenged our teams to develop targeted approaches to find, and then support, visionary leaders with a diverse range of experiences, motivations, and cultures.

The Opportunity

SecondMuse is building an AI-native proposal development platform and we are looking for the product manager to own it and other SecondMuse AI platforms. Over the past year, we've built the foundation: a proposal repository, structured knowledge base, agent workflows, and a competitive intelligence pipeline that includes analysis of winning proposals. The system has already cut proposal turnaround time by more than half. Now we need someone to take it further.

As AI Product Manager, you'll manage and contribute to the platform's roadmap and its outcomes, measured by proposal win rates, ease of use, time-to-submission, and the quality and reusability of our institutional knowledge. You'll spend roughly half your time writing and supporting proposals alongside our growth and program teams, using that hands-on experience as direct research input into the platform. The other half is building: refining AI workflows, designing evaluation frameworks to measure output quality, structuring knowledge for retrieval, and turning every proposal cycle, win or lose, into system-level improvement.

You'll work as part of SecondMuse's Business Development and Technology teams (6–8 people), partnering directly with an AI developer and collaborating with growth leads, program designers, and subject-matter experts across the organization. Once this product has been launched and refined, you will be able to work on additional products.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical writing with a product mindset—someone who doesn't just use AI tools but designs systems that get measurably better over time.

Core Responsibilities

  • Build and contribute to the Proposal Platform (~50%)
    • Write and support proposals alongside growth and program teams to deeply understand what the platform must deliver
    • Translate complex program designs, methodologies, and impact evidence into clear, persuasive narratives aligned with client evaluation criteria
    • Edit and refine AI-generated content for clarity, tone, and narrative strength
    • Use every proposal cycle as structured research: identify what worked, what broke, and what the platform needs next
  • Build, Measure, and Improve the Platform (~30%)
    • Manage and contribute to the product roadmap for SecondMuse's AI-enabled proposal system, including scoping and budgeting capabilities using SecondMuse budget frameworks
    • Design evaluation frameworks to systematically measure AI output quality with versioned, testable criteria
    • Analyze competitive intelligence sources to reverse-engineer what evaluators reward
    • Structure proposal knowledge (past performance, methodologies, bios, case studies, evidence) for efficient retrieval and reuse
    • Build and maintain feedback loops: capture debrief data, evaluator feedback, and win/loss patterns to feed back into the system
    • Partner with SecondMuse's AI developer to integrate proposal workflows with HubSpot, Google Workspace, and the broader toolchain
  • Strengthen the Proposal Process (20%)
    • Document and continuously refine SecondMuse's proposal development workflow
    • Support growth leads in structuring proposal narratives and win themes
    • Maintain proposal templates, narrative libraries, and reusable content assets
    • Identify bottlenecks and design process improvements that reduce cycle time

Core Functions

  1. Support the SecondMuse team's efforts to improve proposal win rates: Drive measurable improvement in proposal win rates, time-to-submission, and content quality by combining hands-on proposal work with systematic platform development.
  2. Build a Scalable Knowledge System: Develop and maintain structured knowledge assets including past performance, methodologies, evidence, and competitive intelligence, that compound in value with each proposal cycle.
  3. Design for Measurable Quality: Establish evaluation frameworks, quality benchmarks, and feedback loops that make the platform's improvement visible and data-driven rather than anecdotal.
  4. Turn Every Cycle Into Learning: Formalize how SecondMuse captures and applies lessons from proposal outcomes (wins, losses, evaluator feedback) so the system gets smarter, not just bigger.

Core Competencies

  1. Strategic Writing and Narrative Development: Demonstrated ability to craft structured, persuasive proposals that communicate program design, impact, and value. Skilled at synthesizing complex ideas into compelling narratives aligned with evaluation criteria. Exceptional editing and quality assurance instincts.
  2. Systems Thinking and Process Design: Ability to see patterns across proposal cycles and translate them into scalable workflows, knowledge structures, and tools. Comfortable designing systems that improve quality, efficiency, and institutional learning over time.
  3. AI Workflow Design and Evaluation: Experience designing or refining AI-assisted workflows for content generation, research, or knowledge retrieval. Able to build evaluation criteria for AI outputs, test systematically, and iterate based on measurable results—not just prompt engineering, but product-level quality management.
  4. Analytical Learning and Competitive Intelligence: Ability to analyze proposal outcomes, evaluator feedback, competitive data, and internal debriefs to extract actionable improvements. Treats every proposal cycle as a data source.
  5. Cross-Team Collaboration and Communication: Ability to work effectively with growth leads, program teams, subject-matter experts, and technical partners. Comfortable translating between business needs and technical implementation.

Education and Experience

Experience comes in many different forms. At SecondMuse, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community of individuals with a wide range of backgrounds. As guidance, we prefer applicants to have:

  • 3+ years of experience in proposal writing, technical writing, research synthesis, or related analytical writing roles
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex ideas, research, or technical concepts into clear and persuasive narratives
  • Experience contributing to or coordinating complex written deliverables involving multiple collaborators
  • Strong editing, storytelling, and narrative development skills
  • Experience with AI-assisted writing, workflow design, or building systems that improve content quality over time
  • Comfort working with AI tools and designing workflows that integrate them into professional processes

Preferred:

  • Experience writing proposals for foundations, government agencies, or mission-driven organizations
  • Familiarity with knowledge management systems, content repositories, or structured information architectures
  • Background in economic development, climate, innovation, education, or community development
  • Experience with HubSpot, Google Workspace, or similar business systems in a business development context

Work Environment
We want candidates who will thrive in fast-paced, high-performing, learning-oriented, and collaborative work environments. This is a full-time remote role based in the USA. Periodic domestic travel may be required. This position involves collaboration with teams across North America. Flexibility to work across US time zones is essential.

Our Commitment to Pay Equity
This role offers an annual salary of $100,000 and a comprehensive benefits package. At SecondMuse, we believe in fairness and transparency, which is why we have a no-negotiation policy to prevent bias and ensure wage equality. All compensation information will be discussed in detail before your first team interview to ensure alignment.

Benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with a generous employer contribution
  • 401(k) with an employer 3% guaranteed employer contribution after 90 days
  • Employer monthly mobile phone contribution
  • Flexible work options
  • Unlimited discretionary paid time off after the first 90 days
  • At least 12 paid holidays annually
  • Generous paid parental leave programs for all new parents
  • Short-term disability insurance
  • Employee assistance programs

Our Hiring Process:
Transparency and efficiency are at the center of our hiring process. Every question you’ll be asked is directly related to the skills and experiences listed in the job description. You’ll get the opportunity to share your real-world examples and explain how your background prepares you for the challenges typical at SecondMuse.

Generally, our process takes 8 weeks from application to a job offer, depending on logistics and scheduling. We aim to update finalist candidates on their status at the end of each week, ensuring you always know where your candidacy stands.

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge is seeking an Enterprise Development Associate – Strategic Accounts to help generate new business with Strategic Accounts by creating market awareness, identifying potential clients, and qualifying leads through inbound and outbound channels. The Enterprise Development Associate – Strategic Accounts’s primary responsibility is to turn leads into qualified opportunities by partnering with marketing and sales to execute lead-generation phone and email campaigns. This role will develop relationships with prospects and act as the initial point of contact, and provide presentations to relevant stakeholders within the account.

  • Conduct initial qualification calls and meetings with potential customers to understand their needs and how our solution may benefit them.

  • Research target leads and personas and create an analysis of the prospect before handing them off to Sales Directors.

  • Refine your sales skills, and quickly learn about our product offering to effectively communicate the value proposition of our solutions and overcome objections and competitive questions.

  • Maintain detailed and updated documentation and lead management activity using Salesforce and other tools.

  • Consistently achieve qualified opportunity quotas, lead conversion goals and key performance indicators (KPIs).

  • You have a passion for the healthcare sector and understand the unique challenges it faces.

  • You are a self-starter, motivated to reach and exceed your goals.

  • You have great communication skills and can relate to individuals at all levels within an organization.

  • You're not afraid to take risks and think outside the box to come up with new strategies for reaching potential clients and engaging with potential clients.

  • You are a team player and can collaborate effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders.

  • You have a keen interest in technology, specifically Healthcare Technology and AI, and can quickly learn and articulate the benefits of new solutions

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, business, marketing or related degree field

  • 1-2 years of experience working in healthcare and/or health-tech

  • 3-5 years of experience in business development or full-cycle sales in a fast-paced start-up environment

  • Experience using Hubspot, Salesforce, Definitive Healthcare, and Google Workspace

  • Polished and engaging communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Strong problem solving skills with the ability to overcome objections and think on your feet

  • Strong planning and organizational skills, familiarity with data analysis

  • Flexible and adaptable with an ability to receive and learn from feedback

  • Strong grit to stick with things until finished, even in the face of adversity, with an ability to bounce back from failure or disappointment

  • Business acumen and customer orientation: exhibits knowledge of products and customer profiles through proactive research

American AgCredit offers a unique opportunity to be a part of a national financial system supporting those who feed, clothe and fuel the world. We are a growing organization embracing collaboration and innovation while delivering transformative solutions. American AgCredit provides a cultivating environment where you truly make a difference for our customers and teams.

Benefits offered by American AgCredit:

  • Commitment to agriculture and the communities we serve
  • Family friendly work environment
  • Investment in employee development
  • Medical, Dental and Vision coverage
  • Outstanding 401k – automatic 3% employer contribution, plus match up to 6%
  • Generous Paid Time Off (Vacation accrued at 26 days annually, Sick Days accrued at 15 days annually, 12 paid holidays, plus 16 hours of volunteer time)
  • Competitive Incentive Compensation Plan
  • Disability & Life Insurance
  • Employee mental, physical, and financial wellness programs
  • The position is bonus eligible based on association and personal performance

Position will be posted until filled.

Overview:

The ideal candidate is a dynamic business and employment law expert and smart problem solver who is comfortable working and leading in a fast-paced and high-intensity environment, with broad responsibility and meaningful impact. We are looking for someone to bring legal smarts, analytic rigor, business sense, a strong work ethic, cross-functional muscle, agile and creative thinking, comfort in unfamiliar environments, and leadership with a growth mindset.

This role requires strong trust and relationship building skills to help solve complex, challenging and evolving legal issues that often have a broad business impact, and shape both responsive and disruptive business strategies, working proactively with people throughout the organization. This role also serves as the primary contact and liaison for Association business contract review and negotiations.

The Deputy General Counsel is responsible for working as a member of a cross functional team providing legal resources, strategic thought partnership and leadership, as well as assistance and consultation, to management and staff. The successful candidate will assist with leading the legal team and managing all aspects of the Legal Department and the legal processes within the Association. The role requires strong working knowledge of corporate law and best practices, employment law and best practices, litigation proceedings and outside counsel oversight and legal and regulatory compliance. This position will lead and work closely with the entire legal team as well as with various members of the Executive Team and employees at all levels of the Association. The Deputy General Counsel may also engage with the Association’s Board of Directors.

The Deputy General Counsel will contribute to overall Association management and performance through participation in the development of strategic and operating objectives, including policy review and creation and implementation. The successful candidate will be expected to work cooperatively, efficiently, and effectively to provide sound and thoughtful legal advice, thought partnership, and guidance to the Association in alignment with the Association’s culture and business risk appetite.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assists with the leadership, management, direction, and general oversight of the Legal Department.

  • Assists with mentoring, developing and continuously improving an elite legal team.

  • Works across departments to provide business partners with legally-sound, practical and impactful guidance that addresses a range of legal and business issues, contractual provisions, and matters involving compliance and risk mitigation and assessment and business strategy.

  • Analyzes legal and business issues through risk assessment, risk management and business risk appetite lenses, rather than simply identifying areas of potential legal risk.

  • Remains current on legal and business developments relevant to the Association.

  • Anticipates and researches or oversees research of unique legal issues that could impact the Association and provide guidance on important legal topics.

  • Assists with compliance training oversight and provides general legal compliance support and thought partnership for the Association’s business functions including Brand, Human Resources, Privacy and Data Security, Vendor Risk, Facilities, Enterprise Tools, and Business Technology.

  • Prepares, reviews, negotiates, and/or interprets various legal instruments and documents such as contracts (including SAAS, DAAS and other technology-focused agreements), leases, agreements, and amendments.

  • Provides guidance on a broad spectrum of employment law matters, including talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, leaves of absence and accommodations, separations, onboarding, wage and hour, internal investigations, compensation and benefits, inclusion and diversity initiatives, privacy, contingent workforce issues.

  • Evaluates employment practices for legal risk, establish priorities for process improvements, and execute on established priorities.

  • Assists with the development of employment policies, employment-related agreements, and templates.

  • Oversees and monitors litigation and outside counsel.

  • Maintains and facilitates relationships with other Farm Credit System attorneys.

  • Represents the Association at meetings and conferences as appropriate and often serves as the primary contact for the Association on complex projects.

  • Assists with providing guidance and thought partnership to the Association’s Board of Directors on legal and regulatory matters relevant to their strategic oversight.

  • Key resource for guidance and thought partnership with respect to collaboration initiatives and assists with execution of collaboration initiatives.

  • Provides support to Standards of Conduct Officer when needed.

  • Provides support for the Fraud Department in connection with Criminal Referrals and SARs reporting.

  • Ability to travel domestically up to 20% annually.

Levels of Supervision Exercised and Received:

Makes independent decisions when appropriate. Works under general direction from the General Counsel. Will lead and supervise members of the legal team.

Typical Education and Experience:

  • A Cover Letter is required with all formal applications.

  • Bachelor's Degree.

  • Juris Doctorate Degree from accredited law school and in good standing with a state bar association.

  • Membership and in good standing with one or more State Bar

  • At least ten years increasingly complex legal experience with particular emphasis on finance and human resources/employment law and related areas of law.

  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills.

  • Exceptional document drafting skills.

  • Ability to understand and align with the Association’s customer service philosophy, including the commitment to quality, timeliness, and production standards.

  • Ability to understand, accept and champion Association’s culture and business risk appetite.

  • Ability to tailor legal advice and guidance to align with the Association’s business culture and risk appetite.

  • Ability to effectively work and communicate with all levels of employees, outside counsel and other outside entities.

  • Ability to quickly analyze complex factual situations, whether presented orally or in writing, to identify the legal issues, apply the relevant law to the facts in alignment with business risk appetite, and advise accordingly, both in writing and verbally.

  • Ability to prioritize workload to accomplish multiple tasks for multiple stakeholders in a timely manner.

  • Ability to pivot on priorities and provide change management leadership as Association strategic objectives evolve.

  • Ability to think logically and strategically and communicate effectively.

Essential Requirements:

Must have the ability to perform basic office tasks and work in a typical office setting. Employee will be sitting for extended periods of time and accomplishing work at a desk and work at a computer for an extended period. Must have strong written and verbal communication skills to adequately convey ideas and work well with a team. Some lifting and moving of items up to 25 pounds required. Work during established business hours and may require occasional weekend and/or evening work. Position requires the ability to travel.

FULL-TIME REMOTE: These roles and job functions can be done remotely, while maintaining our strong commitment to customer service and our business goals. Employees are welcome to come to an office to work if needed, and some travel for team meetings will be required.

PAY RANGE:

Minimum $180,633.33 - Max $361,266.67 Annual

This range is reflective of the national salary average for this position and will be adjusted using geographic variance for physical location of the hired candidate. American AgCredit may compensate outside of the salary range for bona fide reasons not related to membership in a protected class.

Alma is available in all 50 states, with over 20,000 therapists in our growing network. Anyone looking for a therapist can browse Alma’s free directory. Copy Lead

Alma is looking for a Copy Lead to own the words across campaigns, ads, emails, brand voice, product copy, and everything in between.

This is not a maintenance role; it is an opportunity to build a voice from the ground up and make it impossible to ignore. As we transform the creative team from a support function into a strategic growth driver, you will shape the future of a leading mental health brand by breaking the mold of traditional healthcare marketing.

Reporting to the Senior Creative Director, you will sit at the center of Alma’s creative ambition. You will partner on high-level campaign development and then lead the hands-on execution of those concepts through launch and the iterations beyond. You will be the primary architect of how Alma speaks, ensuring our message is bold, memorable, and category-leading.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead copy development from brief to launch—concepting with the creative team and executing across paid media, web, email, and product touchpoints.
  • Write and edit high-performance copy for channels including Meta, LinkedIn, Google, and OOH, balancing performance optimization with distinct brand building.
  • Develop messaging frameworks and copy guidelines that empower cross-functional partners to create on-brand work independently.
  • Collaborate with Product and Growth teams to ensure all business-wide copy reflects Alma’s positioning with clarity and specificity.
  • Review and provide feedback on copy from freelancers and external partners to maintain rigorous quality and tonal standards.
  • Lead brand positioning work, including messaging architecture and tonal development, to establish a differentiated territory in the market.

Who you are:

  • You have 5–8 years of experience in copywriting or brand strategy (agency, in-house, or startup) with a portfolio that demonstrates range across integrated campaigns and voice development.
  • You are a prolific creator who can generate a high volume of strong concepts quickly and move from raw idea to polished copy without getting stuck in the "middle."
  • You are fluent in both strategy and craft, comfortable shifting from high-level positioning frameworks to the granular execution of a conversion email.
  • You have a fearless appetite for taking creative risks and pushing for distinct messaging, even when it means challenging safe or traditional approaches.
  • You are an exceptional editor who writes copy that is behaviorally grounded, specific, and creates immediate brand recognition.
  • You are energized by ambiguity and the challenge of building a verbal identity and organizational systems that don't exist yet.
  • You are a collaborative communicator who can clearly articulate the strategic "why" behind your copy to creative partners, product teams, and leadership.
  • You do not need to have experience in the mental healthcare space.

The SEO Team Lead (AI and Automation) is a forward-thinking leader responsible for redefining our organic growth engine through cutting-edge technology. This role moves beyond traditional SEO management to focus 100% on innovation, revenue generation, and process automation.

You will lead a team of specialists to build "SEO as a product," leveraging AI to scale content, technical audits, and data analysis. Your goal is to maximize ROI by reducing manual operational load and capturing high-value traffic in the evolving landscape of Search Generative Experiences (SGE) and AI Overviews.

Who we are & what we do

At Leadtech, we work hard... and play harder! Our mission is to bring forward new business ideas and empower employees to achieve their goals in the online business world.

Since 2009, we have been fostering innovative and creative techniques across many industries, making us pioneers in online project management.

Leadtech is dedicated to constant improvement and inspiring new ideas daily for the world we live in and the future to come.

If you have a creative and innovative mind, Leadtech is looking for you!

Key Responsibilities

1. AI-Driven Multi-Project Strategy

  • Strategic Oversight: Lead and synchronize SEO strategies across multiple business units or websites simultaneously, ensuring resource allocation matches revenue potential.
  • Revenue Innovation: Pivot the team from "traffic-first" to "revenue-first," leveraging AI to identify and capture high-conversion opportunities in SGE (Search Generative Experience).
  • Automation Roadmap: Co-design and execute a roadmap to automate 60% of recurring SEO tasks (reporting, auditing, content brief generation) across all assigned projects.
  • Audit existing SEO workflows to identify "bottleneck" manual tasks and replace them with automatic scripts, API integrations, or AI-driven solutions.
  • Manage the SEO team’s transition from manual executors to "AI Orchestrators," ensuring adoption of automation tools.

2. Leadership & People Development

  • Team Mentorship: Direct and motivate a team of SEO Specialists, fostering a culture of continuous learning in AI, prompt engineering, and data science.
  • Performance Management: Set clear KPIs, conduct regular 1-on-1s, and ensure the team meets delivery deadlines with high-quality, automated outputs.
  • Resource Orchestration: Manage team bandwidth across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring no bottlenecks in execution.

3. Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Management

  • Create and present automated, data-rich reports for C-level stakeholders, translating technical SEO/AI wins into business impact and ROI.
  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Build strong relationships with Product, Engineering, and Finance heads to secure buy-in for automation initiatives.
  • Predictive Insights: Use AI-driven forecasting to provide stakeholders with proactive "what-if" scenarios regarding market shifts and algorithm updates.

Requirements

  • Experience: 8+ years in SEO, with at least 2+ years in a formal leadership/managerial role overseeing a team of specialists.
  • Multi-Project Mastery: Proven experience managing complex SEO strategies for multiple websites or large-scale international domains simultaneously.
  • AI & Automation Expert: Deep hands-on experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Claude) and automation tools. Proficiency in Python or advanced API integrations is a significant plus.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional ability to present complex data to non-technical stakeholders, focusing on business growth and financial outcomes.
  • Project Management: Expert in Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools (Jira, Asana, Monday.com) to coordinate team efforts across various workstreams.
  • Technical SEO Core: Expert knowledge of JS frameworks (Next.js, React), technical auditing, and programmatic SEO.
  • Analytical Rigor: Advanced skills in SQL, BigQuery, or Google Looker Studio to build automated, multi-project reporting dashboards.
  • Languages: Candidates must be fluent in Spanish and English (both speaking and writing).

Benefits

Growth and career development

  • At Leadtech, we prioritize your growth. Enjoy a flexible career path with personalized internal training and an annual budget for external learning opportunities.

Comprehensive benefits

  • Competitive salary, full-time permanent contract, and top-tier private health insurance (including dental and psychological services).
  • 25 days of vacation plus your birthday off, with flexible vacation options—no blackout days!

Unique Perks

  • You have the option of working full remote in Spain or from our Barcelona office.
  • If you wish to come, in our office in Barcelona you’ll find it complete with free coffee, fresh fruit, snacks, a game room, and a rooftop terrace with stunning Mediterranean views.
  • Additional benefits include ticket restaurant and nursery vouchers, paid directly from your gross salary.

Join us in an environment where you’re free to innovate, learn, and grow alongside passionate professionals. At Leadtech, you’ll tackle exciting challenges and be part of a vibrant team dedicated to delivering exceptional user experiences

What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

The Role:

Halcyon is seeking a Strategic Alliances Marketing Manager to execute joint go-to-market initiatives with priority technology partners including Dell, Microsoft, and other key ecosystem partners.

This role ensures joint alliance initiatives are planned and executed in a way that expands Halcyon’s market presence, enables partner sellers, and supports pipeline momentum. The ideal candidate is highly organized, execution-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve quickly. This person will work cross-functionally to ensure joint initiatives are aligned, visible, and delivering measurable business impact.

Responsibilities:

Strategy & Planning

    • Develop and execute integrated marketing plans with key strategic alliance partners (e.g., Dell, Microsoft, and others)
    • Translate joint solution value propositions into clear messaging and coordinated campaigns that support awareness, enablement, and demand creation
    • Identify and activate opportunities to scale Halcyon’s market reach through participation in alliance-led marketing programs and flagship partner initiatives
    • Build strong relationships with alliance stakeholders and internal leadership to drive alignment and unlock new opportunities

Program Execution & Campaign Management

    • Drive integrated programs across digital campaigns, executive engagement moments, field activations, content, and partner communications
    • Own program execution end-to-end — including timelines, readiness, coordination, and performance tracking
    • Coordinate cross-functional execution to ensure consistency and impact
    • Support regional teams in activating joint programs through scalable campaign frameworks, tools, and partner-ready assets

Budget & Reporting

    • Manage co-marketing investments and MDF budgets to ensure programs are aligned to business priorities and delivering measurable outcomes
    • Monitor and communicate program effectiveness, including partner engagement, campaign adoption, and contribution to pipeline initiatives

Skills and Qualifications:

Skills

    • Experience planning and managing co-marketing programs and investments with strategic alliances
    • Familiarity with the security market landscape and buyer personas.
    • Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on campaign execution.
    • Ability to position joint solutions and into clear market messaging
    • High degree of ownership, collaboration, and adaptability in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment
    • Executive presence and confidence engaging senior internal and partner stakeholders
    • Willingness to travel up to ~20% based on business needs

Qualifications

    • 5–7 years of experience in alliance, partner, or ecosystem marketing within enterprise technology or cybersecurity
    • Experience supporting global technology alliances (cloud, infrastructure, or security ecosystems) preferred
    • Proven success building multi-channel regional and partner campaigns that drive measurable pipeline impact
    • Strong project management, communication, and relationship-building skills
    • Proficiency with Salesforce, HubSpot/Marketo, and campaign/event tools

Benefits:

Halcyon offers the following benefits to eligible employees:

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents.
  • Short and long-term disability coverage, basic life and AD&D insurance plans.
  • Medical and dependent care FSA options.
  • 401k plan with a generous employer contribution.
  • Flexible PTO policy.
  • Parental leave.
  • Generous equity offerings.

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.

The expected base salary range for this position is $150,000 - $175,000. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but are not limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans, as well as our benefits offers, and equity awards.

In accordance with applicable state and federal laws, the range provided is Halcyon’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. Base pay is one part of the total package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and equity in the Company.

We understand it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, passionate, curious, and creative people to develop the exceptional product we are building. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity employer.

The Cloud Operation Engineer at CSG Systems, Inc. will be responsible for the design, implementation, maintenance, and support of complex server infrastructures, operating systems, and related applications. This role ensures the stability, integrity, and efficient operation of enterprise systems, participating in strategic planning and technical leadership.

We are looking for a Cloud Operation Engineer who will:

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly available and scalable server infrastructure across on-premise and cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure).

  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot operating systems (e.g., Linux, Windows Server), virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and IBM AS400/iSeries.

  • Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement proactive solutions to ensure optimal system health and uptime.

  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash) for system administration tasks, configuration management (e.g., Ansible, Puppet, Chef), and infrastructure as code.

  • Manage and maintain enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions, ensuring data integrity and business continuity.

  • Implement and enforce security best practices, vulnerability management, and compliance standards for all managed systems.

  • Collaborate with development, network, and security teams to support application deployments, troubleshoot issues, and optimize infrastructure.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior administrators, contributing to team skill development.

  • Participate in on-call rotation for critical system support and incident response.

  • Document system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies and solutions to improve system efficiency and reliability.

Is this opportunity right for you? We are looking for candidates who:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in systems administration with a focus on enterprise-level environments.

  • Expert-level proficiency with Linux operating systems (e.g., RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) and Windows Server administration.

  • Strong experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, Hyper-V).

  • Experience with IBM AS400/iSeries.

  • Demonstrable experience with AWS including IaaS and PaaS services. Experience with Azure is a plus.

  • Experience with AI tools.

  • Proven ability to write and maintain automation scripts using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Firewalls, Load Balancing).

  • Some Experience with monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana).

  • Familiarity with database systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL).

  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to diagnose complex technical issues.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., MCSA, RHCE, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Azure Administrator Associate) are a plus.

  • Proficiency in English in a business environment is a must.

Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

The Customer Marketing Team at Fleetio is expanding and has an opportunity for a SeniorCustomer Marketing Manager to join our team. In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of programs that turn satisfied customers into active company advocates. This leader will build scalable Customer Marketing initiatives that elevate customer voices across marketing, sales, product, and brand channels.

This role sits within Customer Marketing and will partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, and Corporate Marketing to identify, nurture, and activate customer champions.

Who you are

The ideal candidate is a strategic builder who understands how to transform customer enthusiasm into measurable business impact. They also combine strategic thinking with strong program execution and relationship-building skills to create meaningful customer stories and Customer Marketing experiences that drive growth.

They are passionate about customer storytelling and know how to identify the right advocates, build strong relationships, and activate them across multiple channels—from case studies and references to events, advisory boards, and community engagement.

This person is both programmatic and relational: comfortable designing scalable programs while also engaging directly with customers to build trust and excitement around participation.

They bring a strong understanding of the customer lifecycle and know how Customer Marketing programs support pipeline generation, brand credibility, product adoption, and retention.

Most importantly, they are highly collaborative and know how to work cross-functionally to align internal teams around the power of the customer voice.

Your impact

  • Build and scale a formal Customer Marketing program that supports marketing, sales, and product initiatives.
  • Increase the volume and quality of customer proof points, including case studies, testimonials, reviews, and references.
  • Develop a structured pipeline of customer champions who actively promote the brand.
  • Support revenue growth by enabling sales with customer references and proof stories.
  • Elevate the company’s brand credibility through authentic customer storytelling and thought leadership.
  • Strengthen relationships with strategic customers through recognition and engagement opportunities, including a Customer Advisory Board.
  • Expand participation in events, webinars, advisory boards, and speaking opportunities.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to showcase customer outcomes and success narratives.
  • Improve the company's presence on review platforms and peer communities.
  • Create measurable programs that tie Marketing activities to pipeline influence and customer retention.

Your experience

  • 7–9+ years of experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or related roles.
  • Proven success building or scaling Customer Marketing or reference programs.
  • Strong track record developing customer stories, case studies, and testimonials.
  • Experience partnering with sales teams to support customer references.
  • Demonstrated ability to build executive-level customer relationships.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across marketing, product, and customer success.
  • Experience managing customer speakers, advisory boards, or events.
  • Ability to translate customer success into compelling narratives that support revenue growth.
  • Experience with Customer Marketing platforms, CRM systems, and marketing automation tools is a plus.
  • Strong project management and program development skills.

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
  • Community service funds
  • Professional development funds
  • Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
  • Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
  • Remote working friendly since 2012

Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will.

raw.description:
Building at Check

At Check, we make paying people simple. In doing that, we’re not just building our own business— we’re building payroll businesses together with every one of our partners. As the inventors of embedded payroll, we’re redefining how people get paid and making it easier for payroll businesses to launch, grow, and thrive. Check out the full story | Tune in.

Check is far more than just API infrastructure. We’re a springboard for building and scaling payroll businesses.

Our Team

Payroll is broken. Come fix it alongside a team that’s as passionate as you are! At Check, you'll use creative problem-solving, critical thinking, and grit to impact every business we build. We view problems to solve and jobs to be done as opportunities to contribute to the solution; we ignore conventional role boundaries in favor of the unique strengths and value each builder brings to our team and to our mission.

Join us if you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and redefine payroll. Let’s simplify the complex, make a real impact, and create a better future for businesses of every size.

The Work

At Check, we make paying and filing taxes seamless, enabling our partners to build best-in-class payroll businesses. As a Tax Support Specialist, you own a portfolio of tax agencies from end to end — meaning you're the person who knows them, handles what comes in from them, communicates on their behalf to partners, and gets resolution across the finish line.

This role will own end-to-end tax workflows. When a tax notice is received, a filing needs completed, or a partner has a tax question they can't untangle, it ends with you. You build fluency with your agencies, their quirks, their timelines, their preferred escalation paths and use that knowledge to drive fast, accurate outcomes for the partners who depend on us.

In this role, you will:

  • Own a defined set of federal, state, and local tax agencies end-to-end, including notice resolution, correspondence, corrections, and ongoing compliance across your portfolio
  • Be the direct point of contact with agencies: picking up the phone, navigating agency processes, and following through until issues are fully resolved
  • Communicate directly with partners about what's happening with their notices or tax accounts — translating complex agency interactions into clear, honest updates
  • Balance and reconcile tax accounts within your agency portfolio, surfacing discrepancies and driving resolution
  • Manage a queue of tax issues across your agencies, balancing urgency and complexity without losing track of what's open
  • Recognize when patterns in your portfolio point to a larger systemic issue and bring that signal to the right people

Tools for the Job

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 3–5 years of experience in payroll tax, tax operations, compliance, or notice resolution — with meaningful exposure to both agency communication and operational/filing work
  • Genuine comfort on the phone with tax agencies and in writing to partners — you're clear, professional, and don't over-promise
  • Experience with federal (IRS/SSA), state, and local agencies; ability to research and navigate unfamiliar ones when they come up
  • Organized and methodical — you can carry a portfolio of open issues across multiple agencies without things slipping
  • You solve first, escalate thoughtfully, and own outcomes through to completion
  • A curiosity for the edge cases; unfamiliar notice types feel like puzzles, not blockers

Travel and Office Policy: We build best when we come together on level ground.

The Check team is distributed across the US, with offices in New York City and San Francisco. While we embrace remote work, time together in person is where we do our best work. We offer ample opportunities and encourage employees to attend team off-sites, events, and hackathons a couple of times a year! We expect all employees to attend our annual 3-day company retreat in the spring.

For our in-office and hybrid employees, our offices are open all week. We provide meals on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the team hosts regular happy hours, game nights, etc.

What we offer:

For full-time employees, Check offers company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, short-term/long-term disability, and basic life insurance coverage, effective on their first day of work. We also offer stock options, flexible PTO and sick leave, 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, flexible return-to-work arrangements, 9 annual holidays, a 401(k) retirement plan, and a $100 monthly stipend for home internet and mobile phone expenses.

The actual annual salary for this role depends on each candidate's experience, qualifications, and location of work. Most new hires are placed near the midpoint of this range to ensure fairness with our existing team's compensation.

  • The expected range in San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles, and Seattle is between $92,500 and $101,750.
  • The expected range for all other locations is between $78,500 and $86,350.

#li-remote

We accept applications on an ongoing basis with no specified deadline.

Remote work at Check requires the ability to perform all responsibilities without distraction or disruption, while maintaining quality, effective communication, and productivity.

Check is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, provided they are consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Check is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

Check participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information from all new employees to confirm that they are authorized to work in the U.S. Check does not use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

raw.description:
Job Description

SUMMARY: As a for-profit online education company, content storytelling is vital for K12 to attract and retain potential students. As the Junior Video Producer, you will be a part of the Video Team working to develop storytelling content and coordinating production for video shoots. You are a talented video creator with a strong sense of story and know how to translate the K12 brand into compelling video assets. You will work with the Head of Video to set the creative vision for video productions and with the Senior Producer to execute video shoots. Strong post-production skills are essential as you will be tasked with video editing but success in this role looks like presenting strong creative concepts and effective on-set direction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Creative concepting for video shoots. Responsibilities include:

    • Creating concept pitch decks and video treatments

    • Creating storyboards

    • Collaborating with the design team on graphic packages

    • Suggesting music options

  • Pre-production responsibilities include:

    • Read creative brief for each project and ensure concept is achieving the goals set out by stakeholder.

    • Work with the production crew on shot lists and production schedules

    • Work with the production crew to identify filming locations

    • Pre-interview with on-screen talent to ensure they are prepared for production

    • Identify additional equipment necessary to achieve creative vision

  • Production responsibilities include:

    • Act as on-set director for most video productions

    • Work with cinematographer to ensure correct lighting and camera set up for each shot

    • Communicate expectations with on-screen talent and guide them through their filming experience

      • The majority of talent are untrained so the ability to create rapport, communicate with and coach are essential

    • Ensure all essential shots on the shot list are captured

    • Review footage at the end of each shoot day to ensure deliverables have been captured according to the creative vision

  • Post-Production responsibilities include:

    • Edit videos according to creative vision and ensure final delivery is on time and achieves the goals set out in the creative brief

    • Editing videos as required for paid media, competitions, curriculum and other cross-functional purposes

    • Present assets for review and make necessary adjustments

    • Color correct raw footage where necessary

    • Create simple motion graphics where necessary

  • Generate ideas for future videos and campaigns

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no formal supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong understanding of the video production process

  • Lighting and camera operation skills are strongly preferred

  • Must know how to edit video using Adobe Premiere

  • Basic understanding of Adobe After Effects

  • Ability to tell a creative story through video

  • Strong ability to connect with on-screen talent

  • Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Visio, etc.); Web proficiency.

  • Ability to travel 10% of the time

  • Ability to clear required background check

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • This position is virtual and open to residents of the 50 states, D.C.

Salaries will differ based on these factors, the position’s level and expected contribution, and the employee’s benefits elections.

We anticipate the salary range to be $45,984.75 to $70,000. Eligible employees may receive a bonus. This salary is not guaranteed, as an individual’s compensation can vary based on several factors. The Personal Lines Business Solutions Integration team bridges strategy and execution to transform the business. We align capabilities with industry trends, partner throughout PL to integrate process improvements with technology, and deliver technical solutions that enable change – modernizing how we work and serve. We value knowledge, strong business savvy and contributing to a stellar team environment. If you thrive in a busy, engaging work environment, we want to know more about you!

As an AVP you will be responsible for setting the strategic direction for your area, establishing objectives and key results, including goal-setting framework that helps business and technology set objectives and track outcomes. Ability to execute and influence across different business units and with leaders of varying authority levels. Demonstrated success with large scale operational, project execution with sustained change and improved business results.
